violation_type.title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Individual Attention (26 TAC §746.2401(2))
violation_type.short_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Individual Attention
violation_type.typical_finding: There is sufficient evidence to show that the caregiver did not provide individual attention to the children in the classroom.

finding_variants.text: There is sufficient evidence to show that the caregiver did not provide individual attention to the children in the classroom.
Upon reviewing video footage, infant caregivers were observed sitting in the rocking chairs in the classroom during the day and not engaging with the infants when awake.

This standard was observed and found to be deficient. A 4 month old infant was isolated in a bouncer that was enlcosed by a playgate. No physical engagement between the 4 month old infant and that other children in care was observed.
